values.name: Agreed settlement

values.description: Buyer refused to take delivery Buyer refused to take delivery.

values.description: Buyer disagrees with due date Buyer disagrees with due date.

values.name: Deduction against other invoices

values.description: See buyer's letter See correspondence from buyer.

values.name: Weight error

values.name: Additional charge not authorized

values.name: Price change
values.description: Price change Price has been changed.

values.name: Variation
values.description: Variation The adjustment is a variation from an agreed value.

values.description: Chargeback Balance of one or more items charged back to seller.

values.name: Offset

values.name: Financial reassignment
values.description: Financial reassignment Previously assigned invoice/credit note is being reassigned.

values.name: Incorrect due date for monetary amount

values.name: Wrong monetary amount resulting from incorrect free goods

values.name: Rack or shelf replenishment service by a supplier

values.name: Temporary special promotion
values.description: Temporary special promotion Adjustment due to a temporary special promotion.

values.name: Difference in tax rate
values.description: Difference in tax rate Adjustment due to a difference in tax rate.

values.name: Quantity discount
values.description: Quantity discount Adjustment due to a quantity discount.

values.name: Promotion discount
values.description: Promotion discount Adjustment due to a promotion discount.

values.name: Pricing discount

values.name: Volume discount

values.name: Sundry discount

values.name: Card holder signature missing

values.name: Card expiry date missing
values.description: Card expiry date missing The adjustment was made due to the card acceptor not specifying the expiry date within the filing document.

values.name: Card number error

values.name: Card expired
values.description: Card expired The adjustment was made due to the card acceptor specifying an expired expiry date within the filing document or electronic data.

values.name: Test card transaction
values.description: Test card transaction The adjustment was made due to a test card transaction, used for installing, maintaining or debugging purposes.

values.name: Permission limit exceeded
values.description: Permission limit exceeded The adjustment was made due to the permission limit defined by card issuer or card company was exceeded without prior authorisation. Synonym: Floor limit.

values.name: Wrong authorisation code
values.description: Wrong authorisation code The adjustment was made due to the authorisation code provided did not fit to the specified transaction.

values.name: Wrong authorised amount
values.description: Wrong authorised amount The adjustment was made due to the specified amount not meeting the authorised amount for the transaction.

values.name: Authorisation failed
values.description: Authorisation failed The adjustment was made due to the authorisation needed had failed.

values.name: Card acceptor data error
values.description: Card acceptor data error The adjustment was made due to the data regarding the card acceptor is erroneous.

values.name: Treasury management service charge
values.description: Treasury management service charge Charge for the service of treasury management.

values.name: Agreed discount
values.description: Agreed discount The reason for the adjustment is that a mutually agreed discount has been applied.

values.name: Expediting fee
values.description: Expediting fee The reason for the adjustment is that a fee for expediting has been applied.

values.name: Invoicing fee
values.description: Invoicing fee The reason for the adjustment is that a fee for invoicing has been applied.

values.name: Freight charge
values.description: Freight charge The reason for the adjustment is that freight charges has been applied.

values.name: Small order processing service charge
values.description: Small order processing service charge The reason for the adjustment is that a fee for processing of a small order (an order below a defined threshold) has been applied.

values.name: Currency exchange differences
values.description: Currency exchange differences An adjustment made due to a change in a currency exchange rate.

values.name: Insolvency
values.description: Insolvency An adjustment made due to the partner's inability to pay open debts.

values.name: Mutually defined
values.description: Mutually defined A code assigned within a code list to be used on an interim basis and as defined among trading partners until a precise code can be assigned to the code list.
